about_the_game:
The trial version allows you to experience 4 different climbing routes. The core gameplay is available to players, but the trial version limits the climbing levels to 24. To use more items and experience more levels, please add the game to your wishlist and stay tuned for the official release. The trial version opens the player communication QQ group: 1027062481. We look forward to your valuable suggestions!

1. English

Game Description: A strategic card game that blends Texas Hold'em with roguelite deckbuilding. Choose your path up the tower, master a deck of "Standard & Wild Cards" and "Skill Cards," and win by making the best 5-card hand from 6 each round. Engage in deep, turn-based bluffing and strategy.

Hand Rankings: Five of a Kind > Royal Flush > 1 Sun Wukong + 5 Unique Demon Kings > Straight Flush > Four of a Kind > Full House > Flush > Straight > Three of a Kind > Two Pair > One Pair > High Card. Ties split the pot.

Path System: Four unique routes, each offering different playstyles and strategic depth.

Skill Cards: Bull Demon King (Swap), Tiger Vanguard (Surrender), Black Bear Spirit (Wild Card), Centipede Demon (Bluff), Erlang Shen (See Through), Tathagata Buddha (Silence).

Artifact System: Equip powerful artifacts to introduce game-changing risks and rewards, making every round unpredictable.
